DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myeloid Leukemia

The CBC confirms severe anemia (Hb 8.3), significant thrombocytopenia (platelets 35,600), and a marked leukocytosis (WBC 81,000), which is inconsistent with iron deficiency. The peripheral smear showing immature cells with prominent nucleoli and pink, needle-shaped inclusions (Auer rods) is pathognomonic for acute myeloid leukemia.
